description.value: This face mask with attached air tank can sustain a wearer underwater or in another environment in which breathing is impossible or harmful. A military scuba system is capable of operating for an hour per tech level (2 hours for most Tau’ri devices). A scuba system can be refilled with an air compressor during a long rest by characters proficient in Scuba or Engineering. Scuba proficient characters also gain a 3m swim speed.
